description: Looks up a personal e-mail address (webmail, not the work one) of named people (personal data). Takes 1 to 25 entries in people, looked up 5 at a time. Each person is identified by full name with company name or domain, LinkedIn URL or work e-mail. First it checks this workspace (people sheets, campaigns and kept briefs): a value already saved comes back free, with savedIn naming where it was saved; refresh true skips that check. Otherwise it asks Nock's data sources one after another and stops at the first that finds it. value is the personal e-mail address. Nothing is written into a sheet or a campaign. Returns one entry per person or business in the order sent (index), each with person (whose it is), status found, not_found or error, value and creditsCharged, plus the totals found, notFound, failed and creditsCharged. not_found with sourcesUnanswered means some sources did not answer in time and a later try may find it; error means no source answered. The same entry sent twice is looked up once (sameAsIndex). Costs 38 credits per value found. Nothing is charged when it is not found, the lookup fails or the value was already saved. A lookup can take up to about a minute per entry.

people.description: Who to look up, 1 to 25 entries, each with what is known of them.

companyDomain.description: The site domain of the company where the person works.

companyName.description: The name of the company where the person works.

fullName.description: The person's full name, with companyName or companyDomain.

refresh.description: True skips what this workspace has saved and looks the value up outside again.
